svg.title: Electronic prescription journey from the doctor's office to medication shipment
svg.desc: A doctor creates an electronic prescription that is routed through Surescripts into pharmacy intake and restricted S3 storage. One path enters Prescription Service for Python regex matching; unresolved Nurtec indications fall back to the AI Agent Service. The AI Agent Service accepts eRx data at an API endpoint, checks for MDO notes, and when notes are present runs patient-information and Nurtec-indication agents in parallel before validating both outputs with guardrails and merging at an end node.
